title: Diary Work Already Done on a Cancelled Booking
content:
The diary work already done on a Private Event & Banquet Services agreement is charged on top as well, and it is read from the event request log the desk keeps against the agreement.

1. Where the event request log carries a venue change the desk has approved on the agreement, the venue change charge printed against the package is added.
2. Where the event request log carries a date change the desk has approved on the agreement and no approved venue change, the date change charge printed against the package is added.
3. Where the event request log carries neither, no such charge is added.

Only one of the two charges is ever added: an approved venue change governs, and the date change charge follows only where no venue change stands approved.

| The event request log on the agreement | Added |
| --- | --- |
| An approved venue change, whether or not a date change also stands approved | The venue change charge printed against the package |
| An approved date change and no approved venue change | The date change charge printed against the package |
| Neither approved | Nothing |

## The two charges each package prints

| Package | Venue change charge, USD | Date change charge, USD |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Meeting Room Refreshment Package | 0 | 0 |
| Boardroom Reception Package | 125 | 75 |
| Conference Day Delegate Package | 400 | 250 |
| Seated Banquet Package | 900 | 600 |
| Gala Reception Package | 2100 | 1500 |
| Multi-Day Conference Residency Package | 4500 | 3200 |

## Illustration on hypothetical records

An agreement on the Conference Day Delegate Package whose event request log carries one approved date change and no approved venue change adds 250. The same agreement carrying an approved venue change as well adds 400 and not 250. An agreement whose requests all stand in review or declined adds nothing on that account.
